local_result: For a fixed frequency-label-blind group filter, standard relative reflections obey p_k <= min(1,(2k+1)^2 rank(P)/3^(nr)). More copies in the same diagonal orbit do not change its unconditioned group marginal.
constructive_counterexample: A rank3 filter selected using the observed frequency label succeeds with probability1/3 at growing roots, amplified to25/27 in one available relative iteration. It only relocates the original unknown seed, preserving reference entanglement; it does not decode.
matched_baseline: A public fixed-generator test is compared to direct order-three stabilizer measurements, with separate-copy false acceptance3^(-M). This is a quantum verification primitive, not classical dequantization or a lower bound on label-aware inference.
proof_obligations: Externally review the source-weighted polynomial/SOS and copy-access assumptions.
Do not apply the exponential rank bound to observed-label-dependent projectors or infer memory lower bounds from rank.
Separate synchronized single-group orbit costs from product-group orbits and seed-isotype-changing operations.
Retain recorded frequencies in inference baselines; averaged guess probabilities do not prove label-aware noninformativeness.
Any receiver must extract new useful information, not merely amplify coordinate events or relocate the original qutrit.
Certify source error and abelian-QFT gate precision before growing-instance hardware/runtime claims.
falsifiers: An exact SOS fails coefficient-by-coefficient reconstruction.
Actual source-weighted full good vectors fail the compression-polynomial law.
Extra diagonal copies are granted new group marginal mass.
The label-adaptive counterexample is rejected by a purported universal rank cut.
A conditioned seed relocation or direct fixed-guess measurement is promoted to full secret recovery.
